prompt: Ren notices a hidden process in the logs. His hand stops above the keyboard, his eyes widen by a fraction, then he slowly looks toward Nei without speaking.

shots.description: Wide establishing view: Ren at the keyboard, Nei beyond the monitors; Ren's fingers stop moving.
Cut to a tight three-quarter view: Ren's eye movement leads, then his head turns toward Nei.

setting: A dark incident response room just before dawn, rows of monitors and a silver keyboard.
atmosphere: Cold monitor light, dry still air, fine dust visible in one narrow beam; the room begins to breathe as a vent opens.
continuity: keep Ren's raven hair, charcoal hoodie, silver-grey irises and face proportions stable
keep the silver keyboard and monitor layout fixed across the cut

characters.name: Ren
characters.identity: 17-year-old Japanese boy, pale skin, messy raven-black hair, charcoal hoodie, silver-grey crystalline irises
characters.action: His typing stops; the fingers remain suspended; only his eyes and then his head turn toward Nei.
